# Home Environment Manager v0.6.0b68 - restored features with bounded updates

This is not another feature rollback. It restores the Beta66 window and dashboard features on top of the Beta67 AQI implementation, and addresses concrete excessive-work paths in backend and frontend updates. The canonical domain remains `environment_manager`; existing configuration, unique IDs, device assignments and safety latches are retained.

## Beta66 features restored

- Per-device **Stop when a window opens** switch, both on the HA device and the card. When enabled, a confirmed selected open window requests native appliance OFF and suspends ordinary control. After all selected contacts remain closed for **60 continuous seconds**, normal control becomes eligible again. Physical minimum-ON/OFF, defrost, command acknowledgment, sleep, manual-override and supply-ownership protections still apply.
- Temperature and humidity are equally prominent in the room overview.
- Diagnostics/calibration remain expanded during live state refreshes; translated status explanations and friendly names are separate from collapsible canonical technical identifiers.
- Precise outdoor-data explanations replace a generic Conditions message. All 38 translations are retained.

## Beta67 AQI fixes retained

The AQI source, naming, options, selector and classification implementation is preserved from Beta67. Registered WAQI index sources automatically resolve to US EPA unless explicitly overridden. AQI settings are created independently of sensor startup order and remain configurable when the physical source is absent. Friendly translated control names and the reachable outdoor AQI options page remain available.

## Responsiveness fixes, without weakening control checks

- A controller's status no longer broadcasts an update to every HEM entity. Status evidence is recorded immediately; presentation is coalesced per controller for the next event-loop turn.
- Native-source watchers use Home Assistant's entity-indexed state-change helper instead of receiving every global state event. Supply reassignment replaces the old subscription, and unload cancels pending writes and listeners.
- New native capability controls are considered on capability-metadata changes, including delayed humidifier/dehumidifier device classification, not on every temperature/humidity reading.
- Bursts of relevant source or registry changes produce one room-plan recalculation using the newest observations. Command-time safety checks still read live physical evidence; no fixed delay or polling loop is added.
- Diagnostic property reads and legacy window inventory checks use the already-captured room plan instead of repeatedly scanning all home inputs.
- Frontend state bursts share one animation-frame render, controller lookup results are reused within a state snapshot, and detached cards cancel pending redraws. User input/disclosure protection is retained.

The exact cause of the user's reported Beta66 freeze has not been proven from installation logs. These are tested fixes to identifiable overload paths, not a claim that every possible problem on a full HA installation has been ruled out.

## Validation

Local and CI tests cover all prior Beta61-67 supply/PID/cold-start/sleep/window/AQI/warning/lux regressions. Additional tests exercise:

- 960 logical entities across 24 controllers: 12,000 status changes coalesce to 960 presentation writes, without a global HEM broadcast.
- 10,000 unrelated state events: zero native-facade updates.
- 1,000 native source events in one burst: one presentation write; subscription replacement and unload cleanup are verified.
- 10,000 relevant manager events: one recalculation using the last observation; generated and unrelated sources do not feed back.
- Actual installed **Home Assistant 2026.10.4** dispatcher and indexed state-event helpers, in addition to deterministic adapters. Logical test entities and settings are simulated; this is not a full live installation or appliance test.
- Real Chromium full `card.hass`/render path with over 5,000 states: 1,000 incoming updates share one render frame, diagnostics remain open, idle/detached cards do not redraw, and rendering issues no hardware service calls.
- All 38 languages, narrow-screen layout, exact per-device window-switch routing, metadata-only discovery and missing-plan safety.

## Upgrade

Install/redownload **v0.6.0b68** through the existing HACS repository, restart Home Assistant and fully reload the dashboard tab to replace the old card JavaScript. Do not add a second integration. The manual ZIP contains `custom_components/environment_manager/`. No SAT integration or experimental PID tuning is introduced.
